name: EG-2201
summary: EG-2201 is a synthetic cannabinoid derived from a carbazole core group. It has been identified as a designer drug and is structurally related to other synthetic cannabinoids, such as EG-018 and MDMB-CHMCZCA. It is primarily used illicitly due to its psychoactive effects, which mimic delta-9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC), the active ingredient in cannabis.

pharmacology.text: EG-2201 acts as an agonist of both human cannabinoid receptors, CB1 and CB2, at an affinity of 22.4 ± 12.8 nM and 4.36 ± 2.91 nM, respectively.
